claims: Apple TV+ has officially renewed Shrinking for a fourth season ahead of the Season 3 premiere.
Apple TV+ is abandoning the original plan to end Shrinking after three seasons.
Bill Lawrence is the creator of Shrinking.
Bill Lawrence confirmed that as long as Apple wants more, the team will continue developing new stories for Shrinking.
Shrinking had initial plans for a three-season arc.
Ted Lasso is a Bill Lawrence production.
Ted Lasso extended beyond its original planned length.
Shrinking stars Jason Segel, Harrison Ford, and Jessica Williams.
Season 3 of Shrinking premieres on January 28, 2026.
The Season 3 finale of Shrinking is on April 8, 2026.
Season 3 of Shrinking is currently airing.
Production details for Season 4 of Shrinking are still in early stages.
